label: Scopus and IEEE Xplore
hints: suniv-indexed reaches Scopus and IEEE Xplore with the student's own institutional key. Reach for suniv-search first: it needs no subscription and covers most of the same literature. Use suniv-indexed when the student asks for Scopus or IEEE by name, or when a supervisor requires an indexed source.

A Scopus key is bound to the subscribing institution's IP ranges. From a hosted sandbox the outbound address is not the campus, so a perfectly valid key returns an authentication error. Report that as what it is — a location problem, not a wrong key — and point to running SUniv on the student's machine or connecting the institutional VPN.

These indexes return abstracts at best, never subscription full text. Results are therefore grounded at "abstract" or "metadata": report the method the abstract states, and never infer a design the text would have to confirm.

auth.reauth: Set ELSEVIER_API_KEY (dev.elsevier.com) and IEEE_API_KEY (developer.ieee.org). ELSEVIER_INSTTOKEN is optional and comes from apisupport@elsevier.com.
